promotion.name: WWC
promotion.blurb: The giant. Owned by a sports and entertainment conglomerate that counts everything twice, run by a former champion who swears the old days are over. Three brands, two stadiums a year, and more cameras than wrestlers.

roster.gimmick: The self-appointed Head of the Buffet, who demands to be thanked before every meal. He appears four times a year, takes all the credit, and leaves before the dishes.
roster.catchphrase: THANK me. Then pay the bill.
roster.finisher_description: A charging tackle through the midsection, finished with a breath-freshening point to the crowd.

roster.gimmick: An Austrian drill sergeant who believes wrestling is corporal punishment. He chops chests until they file a complaint and calls everyone 'small person', including taller people.
roster.finisher_description: A stiff, perfectly vertical powerbomb, followed by a lecture on posture.

roster.gimmick: A twin who left the family business to become the most cheered man in any arena. He has one word, and the crowd says it louder than he does.
roster.finisher_description: A frog splash off the top rope, preceded by three arm swings and a bounce.

roster.gimmick: A tattooed, soda-swilling rebel who once quit wrestling, then quit quitting. He talks for twenty minutes, insults everyone in the building, and somehow gets cheered for it.
roster.catchphrase: I'm the best in the building. Ask the building.
roster.finisher_description: He drapes his opponent over his shoulders and drops them face-first onto his rising knee, then tucks them in.

roster.gimmick: A man who dresses like a sofa at a royal wedding and calls himself a visionary. He leads a faction of young believers and never wears the same blazer twice.
roster.finisher_description: A running curb stomp, sold at full price.

roster.gimmick: A barking, bounding son of a famous family who tackles people for a warm-up. He has never once walked to the ring.
roster.finisher_description: He presses his opponent overhead and slams them, then issues a statement.

roster.gimmick: A giant from down under who splashes people from the top rope and then sits down to admire it.
roster.finisher_description: A full-weight senton from the top rope that registers on the local seismograph.

roster.gimmick: A legend's son who claims he did hard time for one weekend. He is booed out of every building and loves it.
roster.finisher_description: A frog splash his father taught him, done badly on purpose.

roster.gimmick: An Irishman who paints himself as a demon twice a year and keeps receipts the rest of it.
roster.finisher_description: A double foot stomp from the top rope, with a short window to pay.

roster.gimmick: A bearded, sweaty, emotional Canadian who has almost been world champion more times than anyone alive.
roster.finisher_description: A running kick to the face in the corner, still pending review.

roster.gimmick: A masked high flyer who breaks his opponent's arm and then asks the crowd to count the sides of his mask with him.
roster.finisher_description: An arm-trap package piledriver, followed by a theatrical arm snap.

roster.gimmick: The masked legend who has outlived three eras and his own son's respect. Still flies; lands slower.
roster.finisher_description: A springboard into the ropes and a dropkick through the middle, one number short of famous.
roster.finisher_move: Swinging kick through the ropes and a springboard splash

roster.gimmick: Once half of the happiest act in wrestling, now furious that nobody remembers their anniversary.
roster.finisher_description: A double-team boot and a seated senton.

roster.gimmick: Kojo Crown's partner, who plays a sad trombone at every opponent's misfortune.
roster.finisher_description: A top-rope elbow that ends in a slide whistle.

roster.gimmick: A pale Irishman who absorbs more punishment than any human in the company and keeps volunteering.
roster.finisher_description: A moonsault from the top rope that rarely hits anybody but himself.

roster.gimmick: A social media celebrity who wrestles like a natural and sells an energy drink between every move.
roster.finisher_description: A right hand with something shiny in it, then a sponsored pin.

roster.gimmick: A Bulgarian strongman who left, came back, and now crushes everybody without a holiday to celebrate it.
roster.finisher_description: A camel clutch so deep the opponent sees the back of their own knees.

roster.gimmick: A gothic Australian powerhouse who calls herself everyone's mother and bites if you disagree.
roster.catchphrase: Mother knows best. Mother hits hardest.
roster.finisher_description: A pumphandle lift into a sit-out powerbomb, with a card.

roster.gimmick: A tiny Japanese daredevil who moonsaults from places nobody has insured.
roster.catchphrase: The sky has no ceiling. My insurance does.
roster.finisher_description: A moonsault from the top rope with impossible hang time.

roster.gimmick: She keeps a list of everyone who ever wronged her and works through it alphabetically.
roster.finisher_description: A swinging reverse DDT, with late fees.

roster.gimmick: Vendetta Viv's very large best friend and accountant of violence.
roster.finisher_description: A powerbomb from a great height.

roster.gimmick: A fiery Irish legend who returned to remind everyone she runs this place, lunch break included.
roster.catchphrase: The Man-ager will see you now.
roster.finisher_description: A seated armbar so tight it hands back a receipt.

roster.gimmick: A young Irish technician with wings on her robe and a lot to prove.
roster.finisher_description: A top-rope elbow drop with a flutter.

roster.gimmick: A former hugger turned bitter turned hugger again, depending on the week.
roster.catchphrase: Hug it out or get out.
roster.finisher_description: A face-first driver into the mat, delivered with a hug.

roster.gimmick: The son of a dreaming legend who finished his story and then kept going, because the merchandise kept selling.
roster.finisher_description: He spins his opponent into a falling cutter, then points at the eagle on his shirt.

roster.gimmick: A kilted Scot who has been robbed of everything he ever held and talks about it constantly.
roster.finisher_description: A running jumping kick to the face, the size of a parking ticket.

roster.gimmick: A third-generation legend who strikes from out of nowhere, if his back allows it.
roster.finisher_description: A jumping cutter from out of nowhere. Nowhere is the corner.

roster.gimmick: A family enforcer who tried to take over the family and now leads a smaller one.
roster.finisher_description: A spike to the throat into a cobra hold, then a drop-off at the curb.

roster.gimmick: A huge man who moonsaults as if gravity owes him money.
roster.finisher_description: A moonsault from the top by a man who should not be able to do one.

roster.gimmick: A gravel-voiced veteran who became famous at forty and talks like a movie trailer.
roster.finisher_description: A running neckbreaker, delivered with a sunglasses toss.

entrance_fx.music: Let Me Talk to the Megastar

roster.gimmick: A tall, spooky Puerto Rican who used to judge people and now just punishes them.
roster.finisher_description: A chokeslam that ends in a short homily.

roster.gimmick: A pudgy, ferocious Quebecer who swears at children and powerbombs men onto ring aprons.
roster.catchphrase: Fight me. Then buy me fries.
roster.finisher_description: A powerbomb onto the hardest part of the ring apron.

roster.gimmick: A slick high flyer who insists he is the main character, whoever that is.
roster.catchphrase: Main character energy. Side character results.
roster.finisher_description: A falling leg drop off the top rope with a long pause.

roster.ring_name: Ace of the Block Party Boys
roster.gimmick: Half of a tag team that turns every entrance into a block party.
roster.finisher_description: A frog splash with a party horn.

look.name: Ace of the Block Party Boys

roster.ring_name: Deuce of the Block Party Boys
roster.gimmick: The other half, who carries the speakers.
roster.finisher_description: A spinning spinebuster.

look.name: Deuce of the Block Party Boys

roster.gimmick: A blonde former gymnast who believes the universe revolves around her, and the camera crew agrees.
roster.finisher_description: A moonsault with a full pause to pose.

roster.gimmick: A second-generation legend who has held every title, twice, and is offended you forgot.
roster.finisher_description: A forward somersault into a cutter, then a ten-minute strut.

roster.gimmick: A massive Samoan who sits on people and calls it a submission.
roster.catchphrase: Not like most people. Like most buildings.
roster.finisher_description: A leg drop off the top rope, followed by the building's structural engineer.

roster.gimmick: A sculpted powerhouse who looks like a superhero and does not need to tell you so.
roster.finisher_description: A rolling cutter so fast the replay needs a replay.

roster.gimmick: A sprinter with a braid that is legally a weapon.
roster.finisher_description: A fireman's carry into a facebuster.

roster.gimmick: A dancing veteran with glowing gear who turned nasty after twenty years of being nice.
roster.finisher_description: A running hip attack that leaves a mark you can see in the dark.

roster.gimmick: An Italian-Japanese bruiser who came from the best women's company in the world and wants everyone to know it.
roster.finisher_description: A northern lights suplex turned into a powerbomb.

roster.gimmick: A Canadian who demands to speak to the manager of every match she loses.
roster.catchphrase: I want to speak to the MANAGER.
roster.finisher_description: A double-arm DDT that leaves a form to fill in.

entrance_fx.music: I Would Like to Speak to the Theme

roster.gimmick: A smooth talker who changed his name to sound holier and his attitude to sound worse.
roster.finisher_description: A rolling cutter.

roster.gimmick: A tracksuited would-be mob boss who offers you a deal you would be wise to refuse.
roster.finisher_description: A spinebuster into the mat.

roster.gimmick: Half of a huggable tag team who apologise after every slam.
roster.finisher_description: A sit-out powerbomb.

entrance_fx.music: Tank and Hank, Hank and Tank

roster.gimmick: The other half, who hugs the referee after every win.
roster.finisher_description: A bear hug into a slam.

entrance_fx.music: Tank and Hank, Hank and Tank

roster.gimmick: The leader of a gang of influencers who film every beating for their followers.
roster.finisher_description: A running lariat.

roster.gimmick: A surfer who flips off the top rope like she is catching a wave.
roster.finisher_description: A springboard moonsault into a cutter.

roster.gimmick: A mixed martial artist who kicks like a door slamming and celebrates like a nightclub.
roster.finisher_description: A spinning back kick.

roster.gimmick: A bouncing super-fan who won a contract and still cannot believe it, loudly.
roster.finisher_description: A kimura lock.

roster.gimmick: A towering Nigerian who lifts men like luggage and wonders why the main roster has not called.
roster.finisher_description: A pop-up powerbomb from shoulder height.

roster.gimmick: A charismatic leaper the crowd sings about, whether he wants them to or not.
roster.finisher_description: A running kick to the face, delivered with a whistle.

roster.gimmick: The youngest man in the building, who flips like he has no bones and a lot of years left.
roster.finisher_description: A springboard cutter with a backflip on the way down.

roster.gimmick: A veteran who writes his own reviews and they are glowing.
roster.catchphrase: Read my book. I wrote it.
roster.finisher_description: A spinning driver into the mat, with an autograph.

roster.gimmick: A powerhouse who lifts men in her spare time and women in her main time.
roster.finisher_description: A fireman's carry into a driver.

roster.gimmick: A Chilean technician who has held titles on three continents and plans a fourth.
roster.finisher_description: A face-down submission with a lifted leg.

roster.gimmick: A gifted young star who was told she was the future and now acts like it is overdue.
roster.catchphrase: The future is now. And annoyed.
roster.finisher_description: A spinning cradle into a driver.

roster.gimmick: A former champion who runs creative and swears the old days are over while booking the old days.
roster.finisher_description: A double underhook facebuster, bloodline not included.

roster.gimmick: The face of the company for twenty years, retired after a farewell tour, and very easy to miss in a crowd.
roster.catchphrase: Did anybody see that? No? Good.
roster.finisher_description: A fireman's carry into a body slam, with a salute nobody saw.

roster.gimmick: The RAWR general manager, who shouts for security into a microphone forty times a night.
The SlapDown general manager, a British former champion who is disappointed in all of you.
Has called every big moment for thirty years and says 'oh my' about all of them.
A former kicker who yells on commentary and occasionally kicks somebody.
